segments.title: New useBagStore and BagSummary, modified ItemsPage

traceDiagram.title: Items page flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the items page reads the count and the total of the bag store and renders them in the bag summary. It also shows what happens when the user clicks Add to bag or Empty the bag, and how each click reaches the bag store through `addItem()` or `clear()`.

traceNodes.label: Renders a button that emits click
traceNodes.description: When BagSummary renders, [it renders this button](code:src/views/items/components/BagSummary.vue#L16) with the text Empty the bag.

blockLabels.label: Renders a button around the content it is given, styled by its variant

traceNodes.label: Keeps the lines of the bag with their count and total
traceNodes.description:
Three paths reach this store:
- When ItemsPage renders, [it calls `useBagStore()`](code:src/views/items/ItemsPage.vue#L9) and [reads `count` and `total`](code:src/views/items/ItemsPage.vue#L17).
- When a user clicks Add to bag, [ItemsPage calls `addItem()` with the item of the row](code:src/views/items/ItemsPage.vue#L22).
- When a user clicks Empty the bag, [`emptyBag()` calls `clear()`](code:src/views/items/ItemsPage.vue#L12).
